title: Engineering the A-site cations in (Na/K/Rb)3InBr6 halides for enhanced optoelectronic and thermoelectric performance in renewable energy devices
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,20087-20102
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01760F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hudabia Murtaza, Mohamed A. Habib, Quratul Ain, Ahmed B. M. Ibrahim, Junaid Munir
This research article provide the electronic, structural, mechanical, hydrogen storage and optical of (Na/K/Rb)3InBr6 using density functional theory implemented in wien2k code. The mBJ potential is used to solve the exchange–correlation potential.
